item.wayfarer.enchanted_book.smith: Only a smith can put it on a tool or armour. It takes a night.
item.wayfarer.raw_frost_iron.tooltip: Cold to the touch, and it stays cold. No common fire melts it: it needs a smith's forge, and a night.
subtitles.wayfarer.gaze_rises: Something claws out of the ground
wayfarer.afterwards.diggers.door.blind: With the dragon dead, nothing looked down on the forest over their tunnels. Below, the dark still keeps what it took from them.
wayfarer.afterwards.diggers.door.close: When the Eye closed, the forest over their tunnels went quiet at night, and stayed quiet.
wayfarer.afterwards.diggers.door.oath: The dragon stayed half-blind. Their tunnels still run under half the world, and what waits out the day still waits down there.
wayfarer.afterwards.diggers.door.seen: The dragon saw their forest at last, every glade of it, and what waited in their tunnels came up every night.
wayfarer.afterwards.diggers.taken: You took their shard from the bottom of their tunnels, where Wend had cut his sign on the way down and left it lying.
wayfarer.afterwards.drowned_city.door.bl: With the dragon dead, nothing watched the coast where their city lies under the sea.
wayfarer.afterwards.drowned_city.door.cl: When the Eye closed, the sea over their drowned city went dark for good.
wayfarer.afterwards.drowned_city.door.da: The dragon saw the coast where their city drowned, but not the bay where their shard still lies.
wayfarer.afterwards.drowned_city.door.oa: The dragon stayed half-blind, and their shard lay hidden from it, as their last people wanted when they carried it to the sea.
wayfarer.afterwards.drowned_city.door.se: The dragon saw the coast where their city drowned, and the bay their last people trusted. Nothing of theirs was hidden any more.
wayfarer.afterwards.drowned_city.left: You left their shard on the Tide Folk's stone, where their last people had carried it, and the oath they swore held.
wayfarer.afterwards.drowned_city.taken: You took the shard their last people had carried to the Tide Folk's bay.
wayfarer.afterwards.first_village.door.b: With the dragon dead, a town could grow without burning, which was all the First Village had ever done wrong.
wayfarer.afterwards.first_village.door.c: When the Eye closed, no town burned for growing any more, and grass grew over their green.
wayfarer.afterwards.first_village.door.o: The dragon stayed half-blind. Towns still burn when they grow too bright, but someone walks the road who knows why.
wayfarer.afterwards.first_village.door.s: The dragon saw the plains where their village stood, and every town that grew there burned.
wayfarer.afterwards.first_village.melted: You had Maud's bell melted for the shard Wend dropped into its bronze, and she turned her back on you.
wayfarer.afterwards.first_village.rung: You left the shard in Maud's bell, where it had been since she was nine, and let it ring.
wayfarer.afterwards.frost_walkers.door.b: With the dragon dead, nothing walked the snow over their hall at night but the wind.
wayfarer.afterwards.frost_walkers.door.c: When the Eye closed, the snow over their hall lay dark and still, and their dead slept under it.
wayfarer.afterwards.frost_walkers.door.d: The dragon saw everything but their snow, where their shard lies buried with their dead.
wayfarer.afterwards.frost_walkers.door.o: The dragon stayed half-blind, and the snow kept their hall as it had for twenty winters.
wayfarer.afterwards.frost_walkers.door.s: The dragon saw their snow at last, the winter house and the stair, and found nobody left there.
wayfarer.afterwards.frost_walkers.given: You gave Drifa the shard Wend sank in the lake ice, and she buried it with her people.
wayfarer.afterwards.frost_walkers.kept: You kept the shard Wend sank in the lake ice, and Drifa never forgave you for it.
wayfarer.afterwards.jungle_folk.door.bli: With the dragon dead, nobody came looking in the jungle any more, and vines grew over the tunnel the heir's men dug.
wayfarer.afterwards.jungle_folk.door.clo: When the Eye closed, the empty stone behind their locks stayed empty, and nothing came to look at it again.
wayfarer.afterwards.jungle_folk.door.oat: The dragon stayed half-blind. Their shard went back into hiding with the others, and their locks still keep an empty stone.
wayfarer.afterwards.jungle_folk.door.see: The dragon saw the jungle at last. Their locks keep an empty stone, and there was nothing in it for the dragon to see.
wayfarer.afterwards.jungle_folk.emptied: You opened the Jungle Folk's three locks and found their stone empty. The heir's men had dug past the locks with Wend's maps, and their shard came to the frame in the heir's hands.
wayfarer.afterwards.sand_singers.door.bl: With the dragon dead, nothing hunted the desert at night but the cold, and the Sand Singers pitched their tents where they liked.
wayfarer.afterwards.sand_singers.door.cl: When the Eye closed, the desert's nights went quiet. The Sand Singers still sing the song of the man who ran.
wayfarer.afterwards.sand_singers.door.da: The dragon saw everything but the worm's ground, where its shard still lies in the sand, and the Sand Singers pitched their tents beside it.
wayfarer.afterwards.sand_singers.door.oa: The dragon stayed half-blind, and the Sand Singers went on moving their tents across the sand, singing.
wayfarer.afterwards.sand_singers.door.se: The dragon saw the desert at last, and the Sand Singers had no worm left to keep its creatures off.
wayfarer.afterwards.sand_singers.killed: You blew the horn on the worm's ground and killed what the Sand Singers sang to, and the raiders came back to their tents.
wayfarer.afterwards.sand_singers.spared: You walked away from the worm's ground, and the Sand Singers sang you its song. No raider crossed their sand.
wayfarer.afterwards.scribes.door.blind: With the dragon dead, the thirteenth their books spoke of was only a page, and the mountain kept their shelves.
wayfarer.afterwards.scribes.door.close: When the Eye closed, the last thing their books foresaw came true: the one that walks went home.
wayfarer.afterwards.scribes.door.dark: The dragon saw everything but their mountain, where their shard still whispers among the books.
wayfarer.afterwards.scribes.door.oath: The dragon stayed half-blind, and their books went on waiting up on the mountain for someone who could read them.
wayfarer.afterwards.scribes.door.seen: The dragon saw their mountain at last, and read nothing in their books it didn't already know.
wayfarer.afterwards.scribes.left: You left the Scribes' shard among their books, with everything it ever whispered written down around it.
wayfarer.afterwards.scribes.taken: You took the Scribes' shard from among their books, the books that told Wend what you are.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.both: You took both shards from under their fire pit, and Murdo said nothing at all.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.door.blind: With the dragon dead, the bay needed nothing to hide it, and their boats went out with every lamp lit.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.door.close: When the Eye closed, the bay went dark for good, and they stopped hooding their lamps.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.door.dark: The dragon saw everything but the bay, where their own shard still lies under the fire pit.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.door.oath: The dragon stayed half-blind, and the Tide Folk fished by night as they always had, keeping to the dark.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.door.seen: The dragon saw the bay at last, and its creatures came up the sand every night. The boats stayed on the shore.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.drowned: You took the Drowned City's shard and broke the oath the Tide Folk had kept for it, and the deep things came back into the bay at night.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.none: You left their two stones together. The boats still went out at night, and nothing watched them.
wayfarer.afterwards.tide_folk.theirs: You took the Tide Folk's own shard, and after that their boats fished close in, within sight of the shore.
wayfarer.bug.message: Wayfarer's bug form opens on GitHub, with your version, quest and place filled in. Drag latest.log from the logs folder into it.
wayfarer.caravan.ask: Turn back now? The day ends for the whole team.
wayfarer.caravan.ask.waits: Turn back now? The day ends for the whole team; %s waits for morning.
wayfarer.caravan.bowl: Someone passes you a bowl of stew.
wayfarer.caravan.chosen: %s turns back towards the caravan's smoke.
wayfarer.caravan.objective: Make for their smoke, or pitch your tent by a fire of your own.
wayfarer.caravan.objective.camp: Rest by your own fire until night falls.
wayfarer.caravan.objective.day: Walk on. At dusk, make for their smoke, or pitch your tent by a fire of your own.
wayfarer.caravan.objective.fire: Sit with them at their fire.
wayfarer.caravan.stayed: Nobody took the tents down. Tonight the caravan camps where it stood.
wayfarer.caravan.title: Make camp
wayfarer.caravan.turned_back: %s turned back towards the caravan. Make for their smoke, or make camp.
wayfarer.caravan.turned_back.waits: %s turned back towards the caravan. Make for their smoke or make camp; %s waits for morning.
wayfarer.caravan.waits: The day is ending. Make for their smoke or make camp; %s can wait for morning.
wayfarer.clue.not_yet: Not yet. Look at the other %s things here first.
wayfarer.clue.not_yet_one: Not yet. Look at the last other thing here first.
wayfarer.compass.air: the ember does not answer in the air
wayfarer.craft.patterns: Metal needs Hob's patterns: Journal › Gear › Tools
wayfarer.credits.last: Thank you for walking the road.
wayfarer.credits.title: Wayfarer
wayfarer.credits.with: With the friends who walked the road first, voices made with ElevenLabs, and the %s mods listed in the pack's credits.
wayfarer.cut.breed: They will not breed: they shy from the ember you carry.
wayfarer.cut.cold: It lies cold: nobody remembers how to work it.
wayfarer.cut.cold_book: It lies cold: nobody remembers how to work it. A smith could put that book on for you.
wayfarer.cut.root: It will not take root: roots are for those who stay, and the ember withers what its carrier plants.
wayfarer.cut.sleep: You cannot sleep here: sleep is the stillest a heart gets, and only a tent hides it.
wayfarer.cut.storage: It will not stand here: what you keep, you carry, or keep in a tent.
wayfarer.deed.all_twelve.line: All twelve. It can see so much now.
wayfarer.deed.alone.line: There is nobody left to follow my marks.
wayfarer.deed.deep_quiet.line: I walked through the old city in the deep, and its guard never woke.
wayfarer.deed.every_village.line: Sixteen villages. In every one somebody shut a door on me, and somebody else left bread on the step.
wayfarer.deed.hands_clean.line: Not one of them by our hands, this whole season.
wayfarer.deed.held.line: Eight nights the gaze found us, and eight mornings we were still there.
wayfarer.deed.known_on_the_road.line: The road has started to recognise me.
wayfarer.deed.light_pockets.line: I came to the gate nearly empty-handed, and lighter for it.
wayfarer.deed.many_fires.line: Sixty-four fires, and not one of them home.
wayfarer.deed.nobody_left_behind.line: It took the wagons. It didn't take one of us.
wayfarer.deed.old_friends.line: The herder's bread one day, his warning the next. His sheep don't scatter from me any more.
wayfarer.deed.the_dice.line: The peoples' dice like me. The peoples don't.
wayfarer.deed.the_edge_of_the_map.line: There is nothing past the fog. I went to see.
wayfarer.deed.the_long_road.line: I have walked far enough to cross the world and back. My boots have stopped complaining.
wayfarer.deed.the_slow_way.line: Every step of it walked. I never let a stone fold the road for me.
wayfarer.deed.untouched.line: The heir's champion went down in the grass, and he never touched me.
wayfarer.dice.score: Pot %s · you %s, the dicer %s · first to %s
wayfarer.dice.throw: %s and %s · pot %s · you %s, the dicer %s · first to %s
wayfarer.ember.cold: Cold as a stone. He said it wakes if you walk with it.
wayfarer.ending.deep: Far below, in the deep dark, the sculk creeps one block further. Nobody hears it.
wayfarer.ending.frame: The frame goes still. Your friends are alone at the fire.
wayfarer.ending.title: The end
wayfarer.far_sight.marked: You mark it on your map, %s blocks off.
wayfarer.fire.warm: The ember warms by the fire. Until tomorrow's dusk you need no more food than anyone else.
wayfarer.first.dawn: What came in the night crumbles under the open sky. In caves and shadow it waits for dark.
wayfarer.first.far_camp: Their smoke is far tonight. A tent and a fire of your own make a camp too.
wayfarer.first.hall: Whoever built this hall hallowed it: no monster is born here, and no horde follows you in.
wayfarer.first.portal: Obsidian takes no spark. Whatever lies below was sealed long ago.
wayfarer.first.waystone: Someone set these stones along old roads long ago. One folds the road back to any stone you have touched, so it only carries you along roads you have walked.
wayfarer.flare.spent: The ember is spent. It fills again at a fire.
wayfarer.gate.closed: The frame is cold. The Keepers stand round it, waiting for you to choose.
wayfarer.gate.incomplete: The frame stays cold. Your ember holds %s of %s shards.
wayfarer.gate.ward: The Keepers' ward holds: the frame will not take the Eye while a Gazebound stands in the hall.
wayfarer.gaze.lifted: The dragon is dead. The ember goes out, and the sky is yours.
wayfarer.gaze.title: Dragon's Gaze
wayfarer.gaze.veil: Ember Veil %s: %s min in the air
wayfarer.gear.bare: Worn bare: no better than your bare hand until mended
wayfarer.gear.smith: You don't throw it away. You bring it to me.
wayfarer.gear.tracked: Its tasks are under the quest's, top right.
wayfarer.gear.worn: %s is worn to its last. It holds together, but it works no better than your bare hand.
wayfarer.gift.close_words: The words that close an Eye
wayfarer.gift.dark_sight: Dark-sight: the dark shows what's in it, dimly
wayfarer.gift.deep_sight: Deep-sight: the water shows far, and clear
wayfarer.gift.far_sight: Far-sight: far places show sharp through a spyglass, and a strike while you look marks one on your map
wayfarer.gift.flare: The Flare: held up against a blow, the ember bursts, and the night's creatures near you crumble
wayfarer.gift.old_script: The old script: the Keepers' writing reads plain
wayfarer.gift.stare: Stare: the weaker things of the night flee your look
wayfarer.gift.stone_sight: Stone-sight: standing still at night, the night's creatures show through rock
wayfarer.gift.warmth: Warmth: the ember warms you like a fire
wayfarer.grave.rest: Your stone keeps the rest. Make room in your pack, then take it again.
wayfarer.hall.silent: The calling stone is cold. No shard ever rested here.
wayfarer.hall.sinks: The shard sinks into your ember for good. Nothing can take it out again, not even death.
wayfarer.hall.spent: The %s is already in your ember.
wayfarer.handover.feet: Your hands are full: it's at your feet.
wayfarer.hearts.same: The ember tires of the same food: a heart less until you eat something new.
wayfarer.hearts.varied: The ember likes the new food: it gives you a heart more while you keep eating something different.
wayfarer.hint.noted: Your hint is noted in the play record.
wayfarer.hold.cry: %s cries out: something has reached them.
wayfarer.hold.waiting: Where you stand, nothing reaches you. Out in the dark, they wait for you to come where they can.
wayfarer.hold.waiting_door: Where you stand, nothing reaches you. They gather at the door, and wait.
wayfarer.horn.caravan: %s is Pip's horse, not yours to call. Bind your horn to a horse of your own.
wayfarer.jei.found: Found on the road, never made. Armour here is made from a smith's patterns.
wayfarer.journal.deeds.about: What I did that nobody asked of me
wayfarer.journal.dream_again.fire: Sit by a lit fire to dream it again.
wayfarer.journal.gear.about: What I carry, and what comes next
wayfarer.journal.quests.about: What I mean to do, and what I've done
wayfarer.journal.room: Make room in your pack first: this takes %s empty slots.
wayfarer.journal.room_one: Make room in your pack first: this takes an empty slot.
wayfarer.journal.stone.at: It stands at %s, %s, where you fell. What you carried waits in it.
wayfarer.journal.stones.about: What I've left at my stone
wayfarer.journal.story.about: What has happened, as I'd tell it
wayfarer.journal.words.about: Words I've learned, and what they mean
wayfarer.memory.kept: It's a memory. It stays as it was.
wayfarer.night.chat: Tonight nobody sleeps, no tent opens and the horde walks through fire. Be ready by dusk.
wayfarer.night.ejected: The tent unfolds around you. The ember burns too bright to hide tonight.
wayfarer.night.let_go: Whatever is looking has seen enough of you tonight. It looks elsewhere until dawn.
wayfarer.night.no_sleep: Tonight something is looking. Nobody sleeps.
wayfarer.night.subtitle: Tonight, something is looking.
wayfarer.night.tent: The ember burns too bright to fold away tonight.
wayfarer.night.title: A Sleepless Night
wayfarer.night.uneasy_chat: The ember is uneasy tonight. Nobody sleeps, no tent opens, and what comes walks through fire.
wayfarer.omen.marked: His men saw who killed him. They'll take it out on the next village you walk into.
wayfarer.options.voice.ask: The story is read aloud. This voice says your answers and reads your journal to you. You can change it later in Options, Music & Sounds.
wayfarer.ore.frost_iron.tool: It won't come out for that. It needs an iron pickaxe at least.
wayfarer.recap.first: A fire burns low in the grey before dawn. Someone sits by it, waiting for you to wake.
wayfarer.respawn.caravan: You come to by the caravan's fire.
wayfarer.respawn.fire: You come to by the last fire you rested at.
wayfarer.respawn.friend: You come to at a friend's side. The ember found the nearest warmth it knew.
wayfarer.sense.listening: The ember is listening for the way. Walk on a while and hold it up again.
wayfarer.sense.no_road: The ember has no road to feel for. Choose one in your journal.
wayfarer.shipyard.moored: That one is the caravan's. Maud's people are loading it.
wayfarer.step.again.ahead: %s is put down again ahead of the caravan, out of sight.
wayfarer.step.again.hold: Not while the hold at %s is under way.
wayfarer.step.again.never: %s cannot be put down again. /wayfarer step skip moves the story on.
wayfarer.step.again.talk: Not while the talk at %s is under way.
wayfarer.step.again.there: %s goes up again where it stood, out of sight.
wayfarer.step.heading: %s, %s of %s: %s
wayfarer.stillness.dimming: The ember is dimming. It needs you to walk on.
wayfarer.stillness.found: You stayed too long. Something has found you, and it comes tonight.
wayfarer.stone.hungry: You arrive hungry, as if you had walked it.
wayfarer.stone.lore: Cut down from an old waystone. Set it down and touch it, and it folds you back to it.
wayfarer.stone.name: A Stone of One's Own
wayfarer.stone.not_yours: It will not stand here: only a stone of your own can be set down.
wayfarer.stone.taken_up: You take your stone up into your pack again.
wayfarer.stone.tent: The stone needs open ground: a tent goes with its owner, and the stone would go with it.
wayfarer.stone.world: It will not move: the old stones stand where they were set.
wayfarer.talk.hunted: %s is hunting you. The talk goes on once it is dead or gone.
wayfarer.task.answer: Choose an answer: press its number %s to %s
wayfarer.task.bury: Lay him to rest: right-click him
wayfarer.task.campfire: Tonight you need a campfire by your tent
wayfarer.task.charms: Your ember sits with your charms: open your inventory %s and click the charms button beside your figure
wayfarer.task.choose: Choose what to follow next: open your journal %s and press Track
wayfarer.task.claim: Take %s: open your journal %s and press Take
wayfarer.task.cold: Too cold: this land freezes. Get to a fire, or out of the wind
wayfarer.task.cold.coming: Getting cold: find a fire, or get out of the wind soon
wayfarer.task.compass: Follow the gold mark on your compass, at the top of the screen
wayfarer.task.conversations: Missed a line? Every word said is in your journal %s, under Conversations
wayfarer.task.ember: Hold up the ember %s near the dead: the signs glow
wayfarer.task.enter: Go into your tent: right-click its door
wayfarer.task.evening: Sit with them while night falls
wayfarer.task.evening_camp: Rest by your fire while night falls
wayfarer.task.fire: Set a campfire within %s blocks of your tent
wayfarer.task.gear: Better gear: open your journal %s and turn to Gear
wayfarer.task.head: Make a tool head: one of Hob's patterns and its copper or iron in a crafting grid
wayfarer.task.heat: Too hot: this land burns by day. Get into shade or water: out of the sun it lets go
wayfarer.task.heat.coming: Getting hot: find shade or water soon
wayfarer.task.horse: Tame a horse: get on it with an empty hand until it stops throwing you, then ride it to the caravan's fire
wayfarer.task.hull: Mend Maud's hull: iron nuggets in your hand and planks in your pack, then right-click her boat
wayfarer.task.hull.ready: For the night at sea: carry iron nuggets and planks, to patch a hull
wayfarer.task.lantern: Hang a lantern at your belt: the lantern slot in your inventory %s
wayfarer.task.lent: Maud's tent has room tonight: right-click its bed, marked on your compass
wayfarer.task.look: Right-click a glowing sign to look closer
wayfarer.task.marks: Hold up the ember %s: marks on the way down glow
wayfarer.task.mend: Mend %1$s by a fire: a repair kit filled with its material, beside it in a crafting grid, within %2$s blocks of the fire
wayfarer.task.pack: Pack your tent: sneak and right-click its door
wayfarer.task.rest: Rest by the fire: stand near it
wayfarer.task.rest_while: Rest by the fire a while
wayfarer.task.sail: Raise the sails %s; W and S trim them, A and D steer
wayfarer.task.sail.board: Put your ship in the water: right-click the water with it, then right-click the ship to go aboard
wayfarer.task.search: Hold up the ember %s: what was left here glows
wayfarer.task.sleep: Sleep in your tent by their fire
wayfarer.task.sleep_own: Sleep in your tent by your fire
wayfarer.task.stone_set: Set your stone down where you leave the road: right-click the ground with it
wayfarer.task.sweep: Hold up the ember %s and turn: it flares when you face the way
wayfarer.task.tent: Pitch your tent: right-click the ground with it
wayfarer.task.tent_bed: Your tent has no bed: hold one and right-click the floor along a wall
wayfarer.task.things: Fetch your things: the stone where you fell, marked on your compass
wayfarer.task.things.more: Fetch your things: the nearest stone, marked on your compass, and %s more behind you
wayfarer.task.tool: Make the tool: the head and a rod in a crafting grid. Hob's rod pattern and two sticks make rods
wayfarer.task.tracks: Hold up the ember %s: the tracks glow
wayfarer.task.trail_sight: The Diggers' shard's gift: tracks and clues glow on their own when you come near, without the ember
wayfarer.task.unreached: They can't reach you: the waves wait until you stand where they can
wayfarer.task.waiting: Waiting for %s to rest by the fire
wayfarer.tent.behind: Your tent still stands behind you. Go back and pack it: sneak and right-click its door.
wayfarer.tent.blocked: %s stands where the tent goes up.
wayfarer.tent.brought: The caravan found the tent you left behind and brought it along. It is in your pack.
wayfarer.tent.fire: No fire burns beside the tent. Light one before you sleep.
wayfarer.tent.fire_caravan: No fire burns near the tent. Pitch it inside the caravan's camp, or light a fire beside it.
wayfarer.tent.left: Your tent still stands behind you. Leave it: the caravan brings it along tonight.
wayfarer.tent.someone: Something stands where the tent goes up.
wayfarer.tent.story: Not yet: the story at the fire isn't over.
wayfarer.tent.underfoot: Step back: you're standing where the tent goes up.
wayfarer.tent.uneven: Fill the outlined holes, or find flatter ground.
wayfarer.unlock.sailing_ships: Not yet: nobody has told you where to sail.
wayfarer.video.graphics.custom.tooltip: The shader's profile, the draw distance, the simulation distance or the far view was changed by hand. Pick a step to set them all again.
wayfarer.video.graphics.tooltip: The shader's %s profile, the world drawn %s chunks around you, and the far view out to about %s km. Changing any of them by hand makes this Custom.
wayfarer.video.shaders.tooltip: The pack's shader, Complementary Reimagined with Euphoria Patches, which the world is made to be seen with. Off draws plain Minecraft, with light from what you hold, for machines the shader is too much for.
wayfarer.ward.cairns: Leave the stones as Drifa laid them.
wayfarer.ward.cairns.build: Leave the stones as Drifa laid them: build away from the ring.
wayfarer.ward.caravan: Leave it be: it's the caravan's, and they take it down themselves at dawn.
wayfarer.ward.caravan.build: Not in their camp: put it down past their tents. They pack up everything at dawn.
wayfarer.ward.diggers: The stone of the hall will not give: whoever cut it meant it to last.
wayfarer.ward.diggers.build: Nothing you build holds in this hall: whoever cut it meant it to stay as it is. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.first_village: Leave it standing: it is all that is left of the village.
wayfarer.ward.first_village.build: Not here: build outside what is left of the village.
wayfarer.ward.first_village_hall: The stone of the hall will not give: whoever built it meant it to last.
wayfarer.ward.first_village_hall.build: Nothing you build holds in this hall. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.footing: Leave it: someone is standing on it.
wayfarer.ward.frost: Leave it standing: it's Drifa's, and all she has of them.
wayfarer.ward.frost.build: Not in Drifa's house: build outside it.
wayfarer.ward.frost_hall: The ice of the hall will not give: the Frost Walkers built it to outlast them.
wayfarer.ward.frost_hall.build: Nothing you build holds in the Frost Walkers' hall. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.hall: The stone will not give: whoever built this hall meant it to outlast them.
wayfarer.ward.hall.build: Nothing you build holds in this hall. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.last_camp: Leave his camp as he made it: it was the last thing he had.
wayfarer.ward.last_camp.build: Not in his camp: build outside it, and leave it as he made it.
wayfarer.ward.locks: The stone will not give: the Jungle Folk built their locks to outlast them.
wayfarer.ward.locks.build: Nothing you build holds on the Jungle Folk's locks. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.mansion: The dark oak will not give: they built it to hold what they took.
wayfarer.ward.mansion.build: Nothing you build holds in this house. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.reading_house: The stone will not give: the Keepers warded what they built, even if the roof burned.
wayfarer.ward.reading_house.build: Nothing you build holds in the Keepers' house. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.sand: Leave it standing: it's the Sand Singers' camp, and they move it themselves.
wayfarer.ward.sand.build: Not in the Sand Singers' camp: build outside it.
wayfarer.ward.seal: The Keepers' stone will not give: they warded what they sealed.
wayfarer.ward.seal.build: Nothing you build holds on the Keepers' seal. A torch will hold.
wayfarer.ward.shipyard: Leave it standing: it's Edda's yard, and every plank of it is counted.
wayfarer.ward.shipyard.build: Not in Edda's yard: build outside it.
wayfarer.ward.shipyard_wreck: Leave it be: it's all that's left of her husband's boat.
wayfarer.ward.shipyard_wreck.build: Leave the wreck as it lies: build away from it.
wayfarer.ward.tide: Leave it standing: it's the Tide Folk's village, and all they have.
wayfarer.ward.tide.build: Not in the Tide Folk's village: build outside it.
wayfarer.ward.tollbridge: Leave it standing: it is all Tollbridge has left.
wayfarer.ward.tollbridge.build: Not in Tollbridge: build outside the town.
wayfarer.word.close_words: The words that close an Eye
